search: any recent trials on a drug for a condition?
plan how a PubMed query will be parsed
article_details: how often is this paper cited?
fulltext: figures and captions of the article
genes and chemicals mined from the text
export: export PMIDs to BibTeX / RIS / EndNote
save found papers as markdown notes
gene: look up a gene symbol such as TP53
compound: molecular formula or structure of a compound
variant: clinical significance of a c. variant in ClinVar
chronicle: build a versioned research history of a question
what changed in my saved chronicle?
images: find open-i pictures of a disease
use a figure image to find its source study
institutional: set up my library link resolver
library proxy link to read an article
why does the library link fail?
pipeline: save / load / list / delete a search pipeline
what did the last run find?
session: which PMIDs are in this session?
